breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the temperature difference definitions at all. It fails to correct the parallel-flow definitions (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in, ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out) to the proper counterflow definitions (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out, ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in). The output simply states 'Report the final required area in m²' without mentioning or correcting the LMTD temperature differences.
